pages.title: Bearded Seal
pages.text: The bearded seal ($(o)Erignathus barbatus$()) is a large Arctic seal named for its long, pale whiskers.$(br2)It lives on drifting pack ice over shallow seas, diving to feed on clams, crabs and bottom-dwelling fish.$(br2)Males sing long, eerie underwater songs during the breeding season.
